Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original top-down 3/4 pixel-art CHARACTER STATE REVIEW BOARD for TAN NGUYET. Input image1 is a DESIGN/IDENTITY REFERENCE: preserve the four race identities and the corresponding class outfit from it, and redraw them in the required poses. This is a new review-board composition, not a runtime atlas.
Layout: landscape large approximately2048x1536, EXACT four rows and six columns, 24 separate complete full-body figures. Rows HUMAN, ELF, DWARF, BEASTKIN. Columns exactly IDLE, WALK, ATTACK, HURT, DEATH, DODGE. One representative key pose per cell, not a repeated idle pose. Thin subtle cell dividers on flat dark slate #17222a, ivory large legible row/column labels, generous margins including space for horizontal death poses. Crisp pixel clusters and native-pixel-style outlines, consistent top-left light, no smooth painting or antialiasing, readable material highlights. All figures consistent top-down3/4, not side-scrolling, not isometric.
Race identity across EVERY pose: human dark tied-back hair/medium proportions; elf blond/exposed long pointed ears/slim build; dwarf genuinely shorter broad body/copper braided beard; beastkin warm fox/wolf furry face with cream short MUZZLE, upright ears and curved cream-tipped bushy TAIL. Race features remain readable even lying down. Same scale per race across columns, no missing feet/ears/tail/weapons, no overlaps.
State differences: IDLE relaxed breathing-ready stance; WALK mid-stride with one planted foot and opposite arm action; ATTACK a dynamic class-specific committed strike with clear follow-through; HURT torso recoils and shoulders tilt, one bracing hand, pained but no gore; DEATH fully collapsed side-lying body on ground, clearly horizontal head/body/legs, retain weapon by hand and recognizable clothes, not standing/kneeling/fading/gravestone; DODGE a low lateral evasive dash, body leans and leading leg reaches, only tiny discrete dust pixels, NOT teleport/cast or an attack. Body tilt must visibly differ from WALK. No enemies, no HUD, no painted environment.
No additional Classes/races, no advanced/legendary gear, no gigantic auras, no blood, no watermark or copyrighted designs.
CLASS: SWORDSMAN for all24 figures, copying ONLY the center-column outfit of the reference. Practical steel one-hand sword, shaped light steel chest/shoulder armor over dark teal cloth, brown leather belt/bracers/boots and split tunic. Sword real blade silhouette with small warm-gold guard. Sword hand consistent within each character. ATTACK=wide controlled sword slash with a narrow pale arc beside blade; HURT sword lowered as torso recoils; DEATH sword at ground next to the still holding hand, no weapon disappearance; DODGE sword held back close to body clear of face. Header exact "TAN NGUYET / B2 / SWORDSMAN".
